compiled_state.title: Update onboarding SKILL.md Phase 3 to add merge strategy choice question
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: /dso:onboarding asks the user to choose between direct and pr (defaulting to direct); writes choice to dso-config.conf; selecting pr triggers provision-ruleset.sh automatically; idempotent on re-runs

## Implementation

File: plugins/dso/skills/onboarding/SKILL.md (modify)

Add a new question to Phase 3 Step 2b (Generate dso-config.conf / DSO infrastructure setup):

After writing the standard dso-config.conf keys, add:

```
### Step 2b.1: Merge Strategy

Display to user: "Which merge strategy for this project?
  (a) direct (default — simple push to main, suitable for solo or non-technical projects)
  (b) pr (GitHub Ruleset enforcement — PR-based merge with CI gate, suitable for team projects with required checks)"

Default: (a) direct (accept when user presses Enter or chooses 'a')

On (a) direct: write `merge.strategy=direct` to .claude/dso-config.conf

On (b) pr: write `merge.strategy=pr` to .claude/dso-config.conf, then trigger provision-ruleset.sh:
  - Idempotency guard: check if Ruleset 'DSO CI Enforcement' already exists on the repo before calling provision-ruleset.sh
  - If Ruleset already exists: log "Ruleset already provisioned — skipping" and continue
  - If not: call provision-ruleset.sh --non-interactive --repo $REPO
```

Non-executable instruction file: Rule 5 of behavioral-testing-standard.md applies. Test the structural boundary only.

Note: Runtime idempotency (duplicate Ruleset prevention) is already covered by test_idempotency_exits_zero in tests/scripts/test-github-bootstrap.sh. Task 4 only asserts the SKILL.md structural contract.

## TDD Requirement
Modify tests/skills/test-onboarding-skill.sh to add test_onboarding_skill_has_merge_strategy_question BEFORE updating SKILL.md:
- Use awk to extract the Phase 3 / DSO infrastructure setup / Step 2b section from SKILL.md
- Assert extracted section contains "merge.strategy" AND "direct" AND "pr" (the option choices)
- Assert extracted section contains "provision-ruleset" (the trigger)
- Assert extracted section contains idempotency indicator: grep -qi 'idempotent\|already.*provision\|skip.*provision'
Test must FAIL before SKILL.md is updated. Then update SKILL.md.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] test_onboarding_skill_has_merge_strategy_question passes
  Verify: bash tests/skills/test-onboarding-skill.sh 2>&1 | grep -q 'test_onboarding_skill_has_merge_strategy_question.*PASS'
- [ ] SKILL.md Phase 3 contains merge.strategy wording
  Verify: awk '/Phase 3/,/Phase 4/' plugins/dso/skills/onboarding/SKILL.md | grep -q 'merge\.strategy'
- [ ] SKILL.md mentions provision-ruleset trigger
  Verify: grep -q 'provision-ruleset' plugins/dso/skills/onboarding/SKILL.md
- [ ] SKILL.md mentions idempotency
  Verify: grep -qi 'idempotent\|already.*provision\|skip.*provision' plugins/dso/skills/onboarding/SKILL.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet->opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

comments.body: AC amendment: Clarify run order relative to Task 1a. create-dso-app.sh runs FIRST (installer), writing merge.strategy=direct as the initial default. Onboarding Phase 3 runs AFTER (during /dso:onboarding session). Phase 3 must read the existing merge.strategy from dso-config.conf and present it as the current default in the prompt (not hardcode 'direct'). This makes Phase 3 idempotent: re-running onboarding shows current value, user confirms or changes. Add to AC: verify SKILL.md Step 2b instructs reading the existing value as the prompt default.
